title: Aft Pressure Bulkhead Radial Splice — Detailed Inspection

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Repeat detailed and eddy current inspection of the aft pressure bulkhead radial splices at the outer fastener row, required on the earliest airframes as they approach the substantiated flight cycle count.

sections.purpose: This task gives the repeat detailed and eddy current inspection of the radial splices of the aft pressure bulkhead, concentrating on the outer fastener row where the fatigue analysis predicts multiple site damage.
sections.job_setup_note: The inspection needs the aft cargo compartment lining and the aft pressurised bay insulation removed, and the tail cone opened for access to the upper splices. Plan a full shift for the set-up alone. The eddy current set must be calibrated against the reference block before the first splice and again after the last, and both calibrations recorded.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE AFT PRESSURISED BAY WITHOUT CONFIRMING THAT THE AIRCRAFT IS DEPRESSURISED AND THAT THE PRESSURISATION SYSTEM IS TAGGED OUT. Remove the aft cargo compartment lining and the aft pressurised bay insulation. Open the tail cone access for the upper splice positions. Clean the forward face of each radial splice and dry it. Do a detailed visual inspection along the outer fastener row of each splice under magnification, and record the position of any indication. CAUTION: DO NOT REMOVE A FASTENER TO IMPROVE ACCESS. THE FASTENER PATTERN IS PART OF THE JOINT SUBSTANTIATION AND A REMOVED FASTENER MUST BE REPLACED TO THE APPROVED STANDARD. Calibrate the eddy current set against the reference block and record the calibration. Scan the outer fastener row of each splice, working from the lower splice upwards, and record every indication with its position and amplitude. Inspect the gusset assembly D5331130307744 and the lower stringer D5331132123084 at each splice for secondary indications. Where an indication exceeds the reporting threshold, mark it, photograph it and stop work on that splice. Compare the results against the acceptance criteria in the illustration.
sections.close_out: Apply the corrosion preventive compound to the inspected areas. Refit the insulation, the lining and the tail cone access. Record every indication with its splice identity, position and amplitude, together with the airframe flight cycles, because the widespread fatigue damage evaluation is built from those records. Report any indication above the threshold to Aeralis before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: Aircraft up to MSN T00130 above 24 000 flight cycles. The interval halves above 30 000 flight cycles.

safety_precautions: Confirm that the aircraft is depressurised and the pressurisation system tagged out.
Do not remove a fastener to improve access.
Keep a second person outside the aft pressurised bay access.

tooling.description: Eddy current probe, 2 MHz, splice adapter
Eddy current reference block, radial splice
